acceptanceCriteria: A1: Workspace package metadata and Cargo.lock consistently identify v0.2.30.
A2: Release, versioning, distribution, and tri-language parity documents identify v0.2.30 and preserve v0.2.29 as N-1 where applicable.
A3: Format, clippy, workspace tests, documentation, conformance, release policy, and version consistency checks pass.
A4: The reviewed PR is ready for merge with a pre-merge finalization receipt; the v0.2.30 tag may be created only after the reviewed merge boundary.

A5: Post-release v0.2.30 artifact identity, installed-runtime checks, and isolated adopter/upgrade acceptance are explicitly handed off to a successor Work Item; this pre-release Work Item must not claim those facts.
goal: Establish the v0.2.30 release baseline, publish it, install the released binary, and prove adopter and upgrade acceptance from a clean environment.
intent: Publish v0.2.30 from the merged default branch and verify the immutable public artifact with installed-runtime acceptance.
outOfScope: Rewriting prior release truth or historical archive bytes
Changing Runtime governance semantics unrelated to release versioning
Modifying global Agent or MCP configuration
Post-release v0.2.30 artifact publication and adopter/upgrade acceptance (successor Work Item)

scenarioCoverage.expected: Cargo metadata, Cargo.lock, release documentation, and tri-language parity identify v0.2.30 with v0.2.29 as N-1.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run version consistency, documentation acceptance, parity, format, clippy, and workspace tests.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The reviewed merge commit is bounded by a pre-merge finalization receipt; public release identity is verified only after merge by the successor acceptance Work Item.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Record the pre-merge finalization receipt here; run public Release identity checks in the successor Work Item.
scenarioCoverage.reason: Public Release identity does not exist before the reviewed merge.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The installed public v0.2.30 binary governs a fresh adopter repository only after publication, under a successor Work Item.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the immutable public adopter acceptance harness after publication in the successor Work Item.
scenarioCoverage.reason: The public binary and fresh adopter do not exist before the reviewed merge and Release publication.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The v0.2.29 adopter upgrades to the published v0.2.30 binary only after publication, under a successor Work Item.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the immutable N-1 upgrade harness and verify cleanup manifests in the successor Work Item.
scenarioCoverage.reason: N-1 upgrade evidence depends on the immutable public v0.2.30 Release.
